description: This file defines a controller class 'OrganisationContactsController' which provides REST API endpoints for managing contacts associated with organizations, including creating, retrieving, and deleting contact entries.

classes.name: OrganisationContactsController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller managing organization contacts with endpoints for creating, fetching, and deleting contact records.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Creates a new contact for a specified organization, saves the change to the database, and logs the creation action.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts associated with a specific organization, ordered by name descending.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a contact by id, logs the deletion, and returns appropriate HTTP response.
